ns2:section.sectionText: TOPIC: "Ernest Chausson and the Symbolist Movement." This seminar centers on the life and works of French composer Ernest Chausson (1855-1899) as a point of departure for studying the innovations and philosophies of the Symbolist Movement, its major exponents, and its influence on modern art. Topics will highlight the intersections of music and the Industrial Revolution, climate change, globalization, and “the exotic” in fin de siècle art. All participants shall organize and lead at least one seminar session; a written or performed project relating to the seminar topic is expected.
